about: Eval set for the voice fast lane's router (System 1, docs/native/PLAN.md item 0.6). 'logged' cases are real turns from the PA chat transcript, anonymized: every name, company and repo is a placeholder (Person A..F, Example Corp, the docs repo). 'synthetic' cases are written in the same voice to cover what the log does not. 'known-miss' is the turn the old fast lane answered itself. expect: answer = the fast lane may say the whole answer from the snapshot or the conversation; handoff = Jarvis must look something up; action = Jarvis must do something. Every case is scored against the one snapshot below.
